description: List this account's past Oceanir results, newest first: place, coordinates, confidence, depth and date. Read-only: it never runs a new analysis and never spends credits. Accounts with analysis history switched off return nothing. Reads the scene only (architecture, signage, terrain, vegetation), never the people in it. No face recognition, no biometric identification, no person matching. It answers where an image was taken, never who is in it, and must not be used to locate or track a person.

city.description: Optional exact city name to filter by.

limit.description: How many results to return, newest first.

query.description: Optional text to match against the neighborhood, city or file name.

name: list_past_scenes
title: List past Oceanir results
